title: Lock spatial consistency by first building the scene in Newtake’s 9 Panel…
content: Lock spatial consistency by first building the scene in Newtake’s 9 Panel Storyboard + Director Stage, then move the camera through the constructed space instead of regenerating each shot from scratch.
tips: Lock spatial consistency by first building the scene in Newtake’s 9 Panel Storyboard + Director Stage, then move the camera through the constructed space instead of regenerating each shot from scratch.

es.content: Bloquea la consistencia espacial construyendo primero la escena en el Storyboard de 9 Paneles + Director Stage de Newtake, y luego mueve la cámara a través del espacio construido en lugar de regenerar cada toma desde cero.

fr.content: Verrouillez la cohérence spatiale en construisant d’abord la scène dans le 9 Panel Storyboard + Director Stage de Newtake, puis déplacez la caméra à travers l’espace ainsi construit au lieu de régénérer chaque plan à partir de zéro.

ja.content: まず Newtake の 9 Panel Storyboard と Director Stage でシーンを構築し、空間の一貫性を固定します。そのうえで、各ショットをゼロから再生成するのではなく、構築済みの空間の中をカメラで移動させます。

ko.content: 먼저 Newtake의 9 Panel Storyboard + Director Stage에서 장면을 구성해 공간적 일관성을 고정한 다음, 각 샷을 처음부터 다시 생성하는 대신 구축된 공간 안에서 카메라를 이동시키세요.

pt.content: Trave a consistência espacial construindo primeiro a cena no 9 Panel Storyboard + Director Stage do Newtake e, em seguida, mova a câmera pelo espaço construído em vez de regenerar cada tomada do zero.

zh.content: 通过先在 Newtake 的 9 Panel Storyboard + Director Stage 中搭建场景，再让镜头在已构建的空间中移动，而不是从头重新生成每个镜头，从而锁定空间一致性。
